entries.l0.title: History Card · Delivery outcomes not established
entries.page_state_note.checking: This page is checking the file. No value is shown until the check ends.
entries.page_state_note.integrity_checked: This page checked the file's contents, as listed under How this page checked the file. Signatures are checked by capsulectl on the sender's machine, not by this page.
entries.page_state_note.failed: This page found that the file does not hold as a History to show. No value is shown.
entries.page_state_note.unable_to_verify: This page could not run its check on this file. That is not a finding about the file: check it with capsulectl verify --bundle.
entries.lead: Deal copies presented by the holder of key K, each a copy for the audience below. The card shows the copies the sealed selection names and no others.
entries.limitation: A History shows only that the holder of key K presents these copies, each of which verifies on its own. It does not show that the holder of key K made, took part in or owns these deals.
entries.audience.history: History copies: every record's payload withheld; only its time and an act's effect status show
entries.period.note: earliest to latest record time in the selected deals, as the records state them (producer_asserted)
entries.completeness.note: The holder of key K chose which copies to present. The selection does not claim to be every deal of anyone, for any period.
entries.effect_status: Effect status in the selected deals' records
entries.effect_status.note: Each record whose capsule states an effect status counts once, under that status: what the producer's runtime claimed, not that it happened.
entries.effect_status.none: No record states an effect status.
entries.not_proven.title: Not proven by this History
entries.not_proven.value: not proven: the copy withholds the record payload
entries.computed_here: Computed by this page from the records in this file. The file states no values of its own.
entries.recomputed_here: Stated in this file and recomputed by this page from the records in it.
entries.forbidding: This card shows properties of the presented selection and never a score, rating, reputation, rank or trust number.
entries.l1: Each selected deal and its records
entries.l1.later_steps: later steps exist, per the holder
entries.recipient: For {recipient}, as stated by the holder
entries.holder_stated_not_checked: what the holder states, sealed with the selection; not checked against the deals by this page or by capsulectl
entries.l2: How this page checked the file
entries.l2.lead: Each property and what this page found. NOT_CHECKED means this page does not check it; it is not a pass.
entries.l2.signers: Keys named by the selected deals' records
entries.l2.signing: This page recomputes record ids, disclosure digests and each deal copy's digest, and, where the page has a verifier, reads it on the History's own bundle. The lists below name exactly what this page checked in this file and what it did not. The page's verifier does not check a record's signature, so every signature status here is checked by capsulectl on the sender's machine, not by this page.
entries.signature_not_checked: checked by capsulectl on the sender's machine, not by this page
entries.member_not_checked: checked by capsulectl on the sender's machine, not by this page
entries.property.selection_record: The selection record is on the history log's bundle, recomputes to its id and its sealed pick matches its digest
entries.property.selection_root: The selection record is the root of the History's bundle
entries.property.history_log: The bundle is of the History's own log, deal-history/ and the sealed nonce (its checkpoint and the selection record's membership)
entries.property.selection_sealed: The selection the file carries is the sealed one
entries.property.holder_stated: What the holder states with the selection: who the History is for, and each deal's later steps
entries.property.membership: Every carried deal is selected and every selected deal is carried
entries.property.member_digests: Each deal copy is the one its selection entry names (digest)
entries.property.audience: Every copy is for the sealed audience, and that audience is shareable
entries.property.signer_keys: One key, K, named by every record
entries.property.member_records: Each deal's records recompute to their ids and their disclosures match
entries.property.member_logs: Each deal copy is of its own deal log (checkpoint and membership)
entries.property.values: Values stated in the file recompute
entries.not_shareable.title: Not a shareable History
entries.not_shareable.lead: This file is not a History to be shown to anyone: it holds a keep copy (never one to send), deal copies signed by a key other than K, or deal copies outside the sealed selection. No card is shown.
entries.invalid.title: This History does not check
entries.invalid.lead: This page found what does not hold in this file, so no card is shown.
entries.mismatch.title: This History does not recompute
entries.mismatch.lead: The values this file states do not follow from the records it carries, so no card is shown.
entries.not_checked.title: This page could not check this file
entries.not_checked.lead: The check stopped before it finished, so no card is shown.
entries.finding.history_audience_keep: the History is a keep copy (audience keep), never one to send
entries.finding.selection_audience_not_history: the sealed selection is not for the audience history, the copies a History is shown with (counterparty and adjudicator copies are made for someone in the deal)
entries.finding.deal_audience_keep: this deal's copy is a keep copy (audience keep)
entries.finding.deal_audience_not_selected: this deal's copy is for another audience than the sealed one
entries.finding.deal_payload_disclosed: this deal's copy discloses a record payload, which a History's copy withholds
entries.finding.deal_invalid: this deal's copy does not verify on its own
entries.finding.deal_signers_differ: the selected deals' records are signed by more than one key
entries.finding.deal_signed_by_other_key: this deal's records name a key other than K, the key that signs the selection record
entries.finding.deal_not_in_selection: this deal is carried but is not in the sealed selection
entries.finding.deal_missing: this deal is in the sealed selection but is not carried
entries.finding.deal_bundle_not_the_selected_one: this deal's copy is not the one the selection names
entries.finding.deal_not_a_bundle: this deal's copy is not an evidence-bundle/v2
entries.finding.deal_record_unsigned: a record of this deal carries no signature
entries.finding.deal_record_id_mismatch: a record of this deal does not recompute to its id
entries.finding.deal_disclosure_mismatch: a disclosure of this deal does not match its digest
entries.finding.deal_checkpoint_missing: this deal's copy carries no checkpoint
entries.finding.selection_not_sealed: the selection the file carries is not the sealed one
entries.finding.selection_missing: the sealed selection names no deal
entries.finding.selection_entry_malformed: a selection entry is malformed (its deal id, digest or count of later steps)
entries.finding.selection_recipient_missing: the sealed selection does not say who the History is for
entries.finding.selection_record_unverified: the selection record is missing, or does not match its seal
entries.finding.selection_record_unsigned: the selection record carries no signature
entries.finding.selection_record_not_root: the selection record is not the root of the History's bundle
entries.finding.not_a_history_log: the History's bundle is not of its own log (deal-history/ and the nonce its selection record seals)
entries.finding.history_log_unproven: the page's verifier found that the history log's checkpoint, or the selection record's membership in that log, does not hold
entries.finding.history_bundle_unverified: the page's verifier did not pass the History's own bundle (its records, root, disclosures, checkpoint or membership)
